question: Should automatic tool-progress intent become a documented generic Plugin SDK reply contract, or should the suppression remain entirely private to the Slack owner boundary?
rationale: The current branch creates a cross-plugin protocol whose permanent ownership and compatibility semantics cannot safely be inferred from implementation alone.

options.title: Add generic typed contract
options.body: Define a documented Plugin SDK progress intent and make Slack honor existing streaming preferences before suppressing it.

options.title: Keep Slack-private
options.body: Remove cross-plugin `channelData` interpretation and solve accidental progress sends entirely within Slack-owned delivery state.

recommendation.title: Add generic typed contract
recommendation.body: Define a documented Plugin SDK progress intent and make Slack honor existing streaming preferences before suppressing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both Codex lifecycle integration and shared channel progress behavior.
